dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The mobile ClientApp compiles its own copy of basket.proto, which this PR does not touch. Its calls are still accepted, as the story requires, but they erase messages. This is a gap in another client, outside this PR's scope.

dismissed.title: Disclosure toggle gives no cancel/close affordance once open
